title: Project sources.json
description: Traceability record for every external image/video/audio asset used in a project's public/ folder. One entry per downloaded/imported file.

id.description: Short unique key, referenced from script.json if needed (e.g. "scene2-soil-photo").

url.description: The original source URL the asset was found or downloaded from. Null for Local Mode assets with no known internet origin (source: "local").

source.description: Platform/provider name, e.g. "Unsplash", "Pexels", "ElevenLabs", or "local" for a manually supplied file with no external origin.

license.description: License name or summary, e.g. "Unsplash License", "CC-BY 4.0".

localPath.description: Path to the file inside this project's public/ folder, e.g. "public/images/scene2-soil.jpg".
